arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='action.yml'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index("    # Pushes the thread's"); j=s.index("    - name: Save pi thread state")
s=s[:i]+"""    # Pushes the thread's refs/pi/threads/<number> (and refs/pi/worktrees/<number>) if the step above was cancelled,
    # timed out, or crashed before its own final push. Fast-forward only: it never overwrites another run's history.
"""+s[j:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/inputs.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('export function readWorktreeLimits(','function readWorktreeLimits(').replace('''/** `worktree_snapshots`: on unless set to false. */
export function readWorktreeSnapshots(readInput: InputReader): boolean {
	return (
		parseBoolean(readInput("worktree_snapshots")) ?? DEFAULTS.worktreeSnapshots
	);
}

''','').replace('worktreeSnapshots: readWorktreeSnapshots(readInput),','worktreeSnapshots:\n\t\t\tparseBoolean(readInput("worktree_snapshots")) ??\n\t\t\tDEFAULTS.worktreeSnapshots,')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff origin/main -- action.yml | tail -12; grep -n "resumeFrom\|stashState" src/*.ts src/storage/*.ts
